title: ReferenceDesign
description: The cached Grain reference for one product model. Built once per product model and never re-run for a product already seen (a design turn takes minutes). Files are Grain's reference artefacts fetched through the API and stored on the backend (handshake H1, private/grain/); the cache is keyed by grain_project_id + last_build until Grain reports last_build.hash (target T11).

product_id.description: RepairOS id for the product model (not a unit).

make_model.description: Human name as printed on the product label (make and model), or the user's description.

origin.description: grain_designed: built by the team in Grain. grain_reconstructed: Grain modelled a bought product from our brief. none: no reference; discovery mode only.

design_trust.description: high only for grain_designed. low widens tolerances and makes Grain verdicts advisory (I7).

grain_project_id.description: Grain project id, or null when origin is none.

build_hash.description: Grain's last_build.hash (target T11). null until Grain reports it; then last_build below is the cache key.

last_build.description: Copy of GET /projects/{id} last_build at fetch time (the cache key until T11).

files.description: Backend paths of the cached Grain artefacts. Missing keys mean Grain did not produce that file.

model_glb.description: Reference geometry, design frame: millimetres, Z up. Node names are Grain part names (diagnose parts[].name; sub-parts like U1:usb); the BOM ref is a separate field (parts[].ref, null for made parts).

model_step.description: The whole model as a solid (Grain made[].file points here); a replacement part is cut from its node.

harness_csv.description: name, from, to, gauge, length_mm, color, conductors. Ends are not in net pin naming (a part, or a board-prefixed connector; G26).

elec_json.description: Parts, nets and pins (REF.PIN), ERC, BOM rows. No 3D pin positions (G25).

pins_json.description: Target T7: out/pins.json, REF.PIN -> {xyz_mm, normal, part} in the design frame.

main_placement_csv.description: Board parts: ref, x, y, rot, side, footprint, in board millimetres (not the design frame).

bom_json.description: GET /bom: bought[{refs, name, mpn, supplier, url, datasheet, price, qty, line_total, dimensions_mm, why, footprint}], made[{name, process, material, mass_g, size_mm, file, finish}], total_usd.

electrical_json.description: GET /electrical (GrainElectricalReference): nets, harness wires, expected_volts {volts, min, max, from}, SPICE signals.

report_json.description: Build report; domains.sim holds the SPICE run, where RepairOS reads [min, max] for nets electrical_json has no expected value for.

has_harness.description: True when harness data exists for this project.

pin_positions_available.description: True only once files.pins_json exists (target T7). Until then stills target connectors by model.glb node bounds (G25).

design_turns_used.description: Grain design turns spent on this reference (first turn + corrections). Each takes minutes.

corrections.description: Discovery-mode corrections sent back to Grain, newest last.
